Every Rohingya Child Deserves a Future

For decades, Rohingya children have been denied what every child deserves: the chance to learn safely and with dignity. Statelessness, displacement, and exclusion have left millions without access to basic education. Without urgent action, an entire generation risks being lost.

Education is a human right—not optional.

The Rohingya Centre UK (RCUK) is addressing this through Educate Rohingya Children, a community-led initiative delivered via the Rohingya Education System (RES). Taught by Rohingya educators and supported by the National Education Union (NEU) in the UK, this programme brings education directly to children who need it most.

Why Your Support Matters

• 500,000 Rohingya children face extreme barriers to learning
• 60% are out of school, increasing risks of early marriage, exploitation, and child labour
• Older children and adolescents are at risk of becoming a “lost generation”, vulnerable to trafficking and long-term marginalisation.

Your donation helps us:

• Run community-led learning centres rooted in Rohingya and Burmese language, culture, and values
• Train and mentor Rohingya teachers, building long-term local capacity
• Provide structured curriculum, teaching standards, and assessments
• Advocate for education as a protected human right

Current Progress (Pilot Phase):

• Children supported: 720 (target for pilot phase; scalable as resources increase)
• Learning centres: 3 centres (community-led, replicable model)
• Rohingya teachers trained: 25 (pilot cohort; over 500 interested)
• Gender inclusion: Equal opportunities for girls and boys

How You Can Make a Difference

o £25 → Learning materials for 1 child
o £50 → Teacher training in pilot centres
o £150 → Provides 1 year of education for a child

Donate Today

Your support builds safe classrooms, trains teachers, and gives Rohingya children the education they deserve. Every child deserves a future and every donation brings us closer.
